detail:
Decisions: Forward migrate refuses to run when config is sqlite with export_records explicitly false — ingest deletion-propagation would remove sqlite-era rows not mirrored in records/; refusing beats silently exporting from sqlite stores because the user disabled mirroring on purpose.; Migration finalize idempotently appends twining.db* lines to .twining/.gitignore — legacy projects (the migration's exact target population) predate those lines in the init template, and this repo's own tracked .gitignore proved the gap.
Findings: --check on an unmigrated project now reports 'not migrated' without creating an empty twining.db — openDatabase as a read path was a write in disguise.
summary: W3 Task 3: forward.ts files→sqlite migration (export tree + ordinary ingest), 8 tests. Review added gitignore refresh at finalize, export_records:false re-run guard, and no-db --check UX.
